Mina R.: Follow-up from the postmortem — short list of remediation tasks for the recurring eviction pattern. Please claim owners and add acceptance criteria.

Jonas K.: Thanks Mina. Post them here.

Mina R.: 1) Eviction telemetry + deploy-aware alert. Jira: INFR-9450. Suggested due: 5 business days.

Eli W.: I'll take INFR-9450. Plan: add eviction-rate metric, Grafana panel, alert rule that ignores deploy windows. Due 2024-09-10.

Mina R.: 2) Background-job backoff + concurrency cap. Jira: INFR-9451. Due: 2 weeks.

Carla P.: Claiming INFR-9451. Will add `max_concurrency` and jittered backoff, feature-flag rollout.

Mina R.: 3) Runbook + oncall checklist (link to child tickets). Jira: RUN-210. Due: 4 business days.

Jonas K.: I can write RUN-210. Quick checklist snippet below — will add to ticket:

```
- Check eviction-rate dashboard
- If >5% sustained for 10m: throttle cleanup jobs `jobsctl throttle --group=cleanup --pct=50`
- If tail latency >2s for 5m: trigger config rollback
- Escalate to platform oncall if unresolved after 15m
```

Mina R.: 4) Safety rollback automation for config changes. Jira: PM-1120. Need RACI.

Eli W.: RACI proposal: Carla (R), Mina (A), Elias (C), Support (I). Carla willing to implement hook.

Carla P.: Yes I can implement. Will add tests and a feature-flagged rollout plan.

Mina R.: Ops-bot — reminder to check progress next Thu 14:00 UTC. Owners, please ensure PR links and verification steps are added to Jira before then.

ops-bot: Reminder set: Postmortem follow-up 1 2024-09-12 14:00 UTC.

Jonas K.: Also created parent INFR-9500 to track recurrence-level work. Link child tickets when ready.

Eli W.: Linked INFR-9450 -> INFR-9500.

Carla P.: Linked INFR-9451 and PM-1120.

Mina R.: Acceptance criteria recap: owner, due date, PR/branch, verification plan (include small load spec). If blocked, mark in-ticket and ping here. Thanks — see you at the sync. :thumbsup:
